links.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: Tirmidhi-style text with no saying of its own: the first route points back with «بهذا الحديث»; the second route («وروى مالك») is a separate isnad and its saying begins at «بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب»
«الزهري» appears in both routes as separate occurrences, so no shared tail
«قال أبو عيسى» and «قال محمد» commentary after the saying are not routes
